description.subtitle: Tottenham Nike Away Shirt 2026 2027 - Navy
description.tagline: A groundbreaking design for the new era of the Spurs
description.intro: The Nike Tottenham 26 27 Dri-FIT Stadium Away Shirt features an innovative aesthetic inspired by the energy and dynamism of the new London. Its striking graphic design on a navy blue base provides a modern and bold image that reflects Tottenham Hotspur's ambition on and off the pitch.

Tottenham away design 26 27: ​​Represents the historical identity of the London club.
